name: FoMni
intro: A chord harp after the Suzuki Omnichord: hold a chord on a black key, then swipe a finger across the white keys to strum it.

rows.what: Play page: Voice 1, Voice 2, Sustain, Chord.
Rhythm page: rhythm, tempo, drums, auto bass.
Sound page: reverb, space, width, chord reverb.
Chords page: give any black key its own chord.
Setup page: tune, MIDI out, lights.
Next page.
The four values at the bottom of the screen.
Play that chord with its bass: F C G, Dm Am Em, G7 E7 D7, Bb, A7.
Pluck one string of the chord. Swipe across them to strum.
That chord as minor.
That chord as a 7th.
That chord as a minor 7th.
Chord hold: the chord rings on. Same key again stops it.
Strum plate an octave down. OCT+ goes up (one each way).
Transpose everything, -6 to +6 semitones.
Voice 1: the shimmering harp.
Voice 2: the plain harp. Mix the two.
Sustain: how long the strings ring.
Chord: level of the held chord and its bass.
New root note for that key.
Chord type: maj, m, 7, M7, m7, dim, aug, sus4, add9.
Rhythm on or off.
Pick the rhythm: Rock 1, Rock 2, Disco ... Swing, Waltz.
Tempo, 60 to 240.
Sync start: after PLAY, the rhythm waits for your first chord.
Drums level.
Auto bass: with the rhythm on, chord and bass play in time.
Reverb: how much of the strings goes to the plate.
Space: the size of the plate reverb.
Width: how wide the stereo picture is.
Chord rev: reverb on chord and bass. Drums stay dry.
Tune, plus or minus 50 cents.
MIDI out on or off.
Lights: On, Keys (key lights only) or Off.
Save everything now.
After 5 seconds: update mode. Let go early to cancel.
Calibrate the buttons and knobs.
In SAFE MODE: try starting FoMni normally again.

keys.label: Strum plate: 16 strings of the chord, low to high (swipe to strum)
Chord keys F C G | Dm Am Em | G7 E7 D7 | Bb A7 (hold ENV: minor, LFO: 7th)

tips: First sound: hold black key 2 (C) and run a finger across the white keys.
The strings keep the last chord, so you can let go of the black key and still strum.
With the rhythm on and Auto bass on, a held chord is played by the rhythm, not as one long note.
PRESETS transposes, and the chord names on screen move with it: set your key there.
FoMni autosaves about 4 seconds after a change, once the rhythm is stopped and all is quiet. A dot in the header means unsaved changes.
MIDI in: channel 1 notes pluck the nearest string, a chord on channel 2 becomes the chord, MIDI clock sets the tempo (EXT).
checked: Archive fomni-0.4.tar.gz from thefirmwarehub.com/src, folder fm1-fomni-0.4.
Keys: ui.c WHITE_K (16 strings) / BLACK_K (11 pads = indices 1,3,5,8,10,13,15,17,20,22,25); input() strums on white key press, pad_down/pad_up on black keys.
Modifiers: ui.c pad_down(): ENV = minor, LFO = 7th, both = m7; ENV/LFO alone do nothing (excluded from button() on release).
Default chords: app/project.c PAD_ROOT/PAD_TYPE = F C G Dm Am Em G7 E7 D7 Bb A7; ui_init() starts on C (pad 2).

Buttons: ui.c button(): HOME/SEQ/FX/SEL/GLO pages Play/Rhythm/Sound/Chords/Setup, EDIT next page; PLAY on press (sync start arms/cancels); REC toggles sync; ARP chord hold (same pad again releases); OCT-/OCT+ P_OCTAVE -1..+1; SAVE project_save.
Encoders: ui.c input(): SELECT tempo, ALGORITHM rhythm, PRESETS transpose; VIEW_KNOB per page.

Param names/ranges/defaults: dsp/omni.c PARAMS[] (Tempo 60-240 def 116, Transpose -6..6, Tune -50..50, Auto bass def on, MIDI out def on); rhythm names dsp/om_data.h OM_RHYTHM (Rock 1 .. Waltz); chord types omni.c OM_TYPE_NAME.
Auto bass: omni.c C_GATE and step code (gate && par[P_ABC]): with rhythm on, chord/bass are triggered by the rhythm.
Strum plate voicing: omni.c om_voicing() (root/3rd/5th in F#..F windows, five up, root on top).
SEL page: pad_down sets pad_sel on V_PADS; KNOB 1 Root, KNOB 2 Type (K_PADROOT/K_PADTYPE).
Autosave: ui.c autosave() AUTOSAVE_QUIET 4000 ms, not while playing or sounding; dirty dot in draw_header().
MIDI in: ui.c midi_in() ch1 note-on -> nearest string, ch2 -> kb_chord(), clock/start/stop -> om_clock; EXT in header.
Recovery: main_fm1.c OCT-+OCT+ 5 s update mode with countdown/cancel, OCT-+OCT+ at power-on panel_setup(), safe_main() 'PLAY: TRY AGAIN'.
Manual: charlesvestal.github.io/fm1-fomni/ (200; /manual/ is 404), same content as README.
unsure: Calibration at power-on checks raw input bits 0 and 1 (fm1_in.buttons & 3), assumed to be OCT- and OCT+ as the comment says.
Holding OCT- + OCT+ for update mode also shifts the octave when each is released (button() on release); harmless, not on the sheet.
MIDI out channels (strings 1, chord 2, bass 3, drums 10) from the README only, not traced; no MIDI section.
SEL page KNOB 3/4 (Transpose, Octave) duplicate PRESETS and OCT-/OCT+, so they are left out.
